Here's my review of the git diff:

===== Issues Found =====

1. Documentation Clarity Improvement
- Severity: Low
- File: tsdb/chunks/chunks.go
- Lines: 76-80
- Description: The documentation update provides better clarity about HeadChunkID behavior, particularly regarding out-of-order chunks. While not fixing a bug, this improves maintainability by making the behavior more explicit.

2. Documentation Accuracy Improvement
- Severity: Low  
- File: tsdb/head_read.go
- Lines: 420-424
- Description: The comment update makes the requirement about oooMmappedChunks length more precise (changing "<< oooChunkIDMask" to "stay below oooChunkIDMask"). This better reflects the actual implementation and requirements.

===== Non-claim Risks =====
- The changes are purely documentation/comments and don't modify any actual code logic
- No performance impact or functional changes
- Changes appear to be clarifying existing behavior rather than introducing new concepts
- The documentation improvements help future maintainers understand the chunk ID handling better

===== Overall Assessment =====
These changes represent positive documentation improvements with no negative impact. The severity of all issues is low since they don't affect runtime behavior. The changes make the codebase more maintainable by better documenting the chunk ID handling logic.
